svg.title: A-410 South Elevation — Scheme B “Arcade”
svg.text: 1.95 m DEEPEST · 0.90 m SHALLOWEST · 11.2 m² A FLOOR
THE BALCONY CURVE IN PLAN — IT CANNOT SHOW IN ELEVATION
Masonry wall cut by section — 200 mm
Internal stud or block partition, 120 mm
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Preliminary — the exterior only. The plans, site plan and
section are agreed at P14 and nothing here changes them:
same five levels, same 9.50 × 13.50 m footprint, same 1.00
m setbacks, same openings. Only the skin differs between
2. Every opening drawn here is read from the plan it belongs
to rather than redrawn, and checks.py fails the build if
an elevation ever shows one the plan does not have.
3. Scheme B takes its ornament, not its shape, from the
classical reference: ivory render with terracotta bands at
every floor line, moulded surrounds, round-arched heads
with keystones, and wrought-iron balustrade panels on the
4. The entrance is a recessed arched porch with a tiled hood,
not a projecting portico. The cantilever already gives
1.96 m of cover over the front door and the forecourt has
5. The balcony curve is a bowed centre bay — flanks at 0.90 m
with a 5.00 m bow swelling to 1.95 m, blended so the bow
meets the flanks tangentially. Centred on the frontage
rather than the door, because symmetry is the whole
6. It costs more area than scheme A: 11.2 m² a floor, 25 m²
over the four levels. Adopting it re-issues A-000 and
7. No pitched roof and no dome. Both raise the building, and
at +16.45 the penthouse is already a fourth storey for
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
